name: Lifestyle desk scene
description: The product in a lived-in desk scene with a few honest props and morning light. Use it when a plain packshot feels too cold for the channel.
prompt: Lifestyle photograph: the product in image 1, unchanged in shape, colour and label, standing on a {{ desk }} desk among a few honest props: {{ props }}. Morning light across the desk from one side, natural clutter but nothing covering the product, shallow depth of field so the background softens. Label sharp and readable. No text, no watermark.
negative_prompt: staged perfection, warped label, duplicated product, text, watermark, props covering the label

slots.name: props
slots.label: Props
slots.default: an open notebook and a warm mug
